design_vision: A modern, culturally resonant Qatari food rescue platform. Blending earthy warmth with organic UI patterns (anti-grid touches, soft curves) to feel distinctly local but globally sophisticated. Avoids rigid, clinical SaaS aesthetics; instead, uses the 'Neo-minimalism' approach with soft shadows, tactile surfaces, and generous spacing.

layout_spacing.container: max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col bg-background relative shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-black/5
layout_spacing.content_area: flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-24 px-4 sm:px-6 pt-6

bottom_tab_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center z-50

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-semibold active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-accent/10 text-accent rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-semibold active:scale-95 transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary/20 text-primary rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-semibold active:bg-primary/5

cards.default: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-border shadow-sm p-5
cards.interactive: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-border shadow-sm p-5 active:bg-alt transition-colors cursor-pointer

inputs.text: bg-alt border-transparent rounded-xl focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary px-4 py-3 h-14 w-full text-base
inputs.select: bg-alt border-transparent rounded-xl px-4 py-3 h-14 w-full

accessibility.rtl_support: Use logical properties (e.g., ms-4 instead of ml-4, pe-4 instead of pr-4, start/end alignments). Entire app must toggle dir='ltr' to dir='rtl' dynamically based on language state.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text meets APCA criteria against soft beige backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='home-donate-button').

screens.name: Splash Screen
screens.details: Full-screen primary color (Maroon) with a subtle geometric background pattern. Center aligned Nekhwa / نخوة logo. Smooth fade out after 2s.

screens.name: Role Selection
screens.details: White background. Large heading 'How would you like to help?'. Grid of cards for roles: Individual Donor, Org Donor, Volunteer, NGO. Cards feature large icons, soft green active states.

screens.name: Home Screen
screens.details: Top bar: User greeting + Language toggle (EN/AR). Hero card: Impact summary (Meals rescued). Grid of Quick Actions: 'Donate Food', 'Volunteer Delivery', 'Request Food'. Bottom Tab Navigation.

screens.name: Quick Donation Form
screens.details: Step-by-step mobile-friendly form. 1. Photo Upload (mock camera UI). 2. Food description & Meal count (under 50). 3. Safety Check checkboxes (Allergens, Expiry). 4. Location Picker (static dropdown of Qatar areas).

screens.name: Delivery Task List (Volunteer)
screens.details: List of available food rescues. Each card shows pickup location, drop-off NGO, distance, and meal count. 'Accept Rescue' CTA in accent green.

screens.name: Impact Dashboard
screens.details: Visual heavy. Use Shadcn charts (Recharts) to show Meals Rescued, Waste Reduced (kg), and Areas Served. Large typography for key metrics. Soft, rounded bar charts in Maroon and Green.

icon_strategy.style: stroke-width: 2, slightly rounded caps. Use distinct colors (primary or accent) for active state icons.

motion_strategy.transitions: Use Framer Motion for page transitions (slide in from right for forward navigation, slide out to right for back). List items should stagger in softly from the bottom.
